rollingAudit.2024: Target: Reclaim RMB 10B+ revenue milestone ('Back to 10 Billion') and acquire offline discount snack chains (Love Snacks / Ailingshi). Outcome: Accomplished (FY24 Revenue surged +49.3% to RMB 10.62B; Net Profit +85.5% to RMB 408M).

rollingAudit.2023: Target: Pivot aggressively into booming offline bulk snack discount chains (Busy Ming, Wancheng) with customized small-grammage packs. Outcome: Accomplished (Bulk discount channel surged >100% in H2 2023).
